claim: The 2025 gift window, days 44 to 73, carries nothing that transfers to the 2026 window. Four independent attempts, each removing a different objection to the previous one.

attempts.what: 121_offline_gift_holdout, a model trained on the same-season 2025 holdout
attempts.result: public 1.7621018713; frozen conditional direction was nonpositive

attempts.what: extended anchor range back to day 43, no validity channel
attempts.objection_removed: none; the window is 90 percent left padding

attempts.what: the same with a validity channel marking real days
attempts.objection_removed: padding; the channel recovered 0.0245 of standalone quality

attempts.what: the same plus four calendar channels, so the network can finally represent WHICH season each anchor sits in
attempts.objection_removed: the network could not distinguish the same-season anchor from any other

conclusion: Each attempt removed the objection that explained the previous failure, and the result did not move. The year-over-year shape of this season does not repeat at the user level. This is now a measured property of the data rather than a limitation of the models.
collateral: Calendar channels also fail on the standard anchor range at -0.0000132. With fourteen anchors spanning July to February there is no seasonal function to generalise, and the competition window lies outside that range in any case.
